title: Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect
description:
About The Company

We are calling candidates on behalf of a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, It provides a comprehensive range of solutions in the areas of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over two decades in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across multiple industry verticals

Position: Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect to lead the design, implementation, security, automation, and operations of our enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available platforms while ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and business continuity.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise across cloud infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, automation, DevSecOps, disaster recovery, and enterprise architecture. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, product, operations, and business teams to deliver secure and reliable technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

* Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS.
* Architect scalable, secure, and highly available cloud platforms.
* Build and manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent).
* Design multi-environment deployment strategies for development, testing, staging, and production.
* Drive cloud modernization and infrastructure optimization initiatives.

Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

* Manage enterprise Windows and Linux server environments.
* Design and maintain networking components including Load Balancers, Firewalls, VPNs, NAT, DNS, Reverse Proxies, and Virtual Networks.
* Administer storage, virtualization, compute, and enterprise infrastructure services.
* Manage backup infrastructure and recovery solutions.

Information Security

* Design and implement secure infrastructure following security-by-design principles.
* Implement Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, RBAC, and Privileged Access Management.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, secrets management, encryption, and key management.
* Secure cloud platforms, Kubernetes environments, and enterprise workloads.
* Implement network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, and endpoint security.
* Conduct infrastructure hardening and security baseline implementation.
* Support vulnerability management, remediation, and security risk reduction.

Security Operations

* Manage and optimize enterprise security tools including SIEM, EDR, IAM, DLP, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Support incident response, threat investigations, and security monitoring.
* Implement security automation and orchestration where applicable.
* Collaborate with internal teams to strengthen the organization's security posture.

High Availability & Business Continuity

* Design High Availability (HA) architectures across multiple regions and availability zones.
* Define and implement Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
* Establish backup policies, recovery procedures, and business continuity plans.
* Define and achieve RPO, RTO, and service availability objectives.
* Conduct disaster recovery testing and resilience assessments.

Automation & DevSecOps

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure governance practices.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation and standardization.

Monitoring & Operations

* Implement enterprise monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability solutions.
* Perform proactive performance tuning, capacity planning, and root cause analysis.
* Ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Define operational standards, documentation, and best practices.

Compliance & Governance

* Support compliance initiatives including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other regulatory frameworks.
* Participate in internal and external security audits.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure and security documentation.
* Implement governance controls for cloud, infrastructure, and security operations.

Cost Optimization

* Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure costs.
* Recommend architecture improvements for performance and cost efficiency.
* Drive infrastructure utilization and resource optimization initiatives.

Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, IT, and Security teams.
* Support customer security assessments, technical due diligence, and infrastructure-related RFPs/RFIs.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering and operations teams.

Required Skills & Experience

* 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Cloud, and Information Security.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools.
* Strong networking knowledge including Firewalls, Load Balancers, VPNs, DNS, NAT, Proxies, and Routing.
* Deep understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, RBAC, and directory services.
* Experience with enterprise security technologies including SIEM, EDR, DLP, Vulnerability Management, and Endpoint Security.
* Strong experience with Windows and Linux administration.
* Experience implementing High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, and Business Continuity solutions.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud security frameworks, Zero Trust, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar compliance programs.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or cybersecurity certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, or equivalent security platforms.
* Experience with container security and cloud-native security solutions.
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization practices.
* Experience working in SaaS or product engineering environments.
* Exposure to AI-enabled security tools and automation.

title: TC-CS-AD-Cyber LDE
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CYBER LARGE DEAL GROUP**
**Cyber Solutions Architect**
Pre-Sales | Client Storytelling | Commercial & Pricing | Turnkey Cyber Services
  
  
**Executive mandate to**
Shape and lead differentiated, executable and commercially compelling turnkey cyber services propositions for strategic pursuits, converting complex client priorities into a persuasive value story, integrated architecture, delivery model and price-to-win.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Cyber Large Deal Engine brings together Business Case Researchers, Cyber Domain Specialists, Solution Architects, and Finance & Commercial Specialists to create an integrated deal-shaping capability, connecting client and market insight, deep cyber expertise, end-to-end solution architecture, and commercial modelling to build propositions that are differentiated, deliverable and positioned to win.
  
  
It is a senior pursuit leadership position for an architect who can operate credibly across the boardroom, the solution room and the commercial model. The role requires breadth across cyber domains, depth in at least one major cyber capability, and the judgement to integrate specialist inputs into one coherent, differentiated and deliverable proposition.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
**Lead strategic solutioning and pursuits**

* Own the solution from qualification and discovery through business case build out , architecture, proposal development, governance, oral presentation, negotiation and BAFO.
* Establish the solution strategy, win themes, design principles and response plan for complex RFPs, RFIs and proactive pursuits.
* Translate client requirements into an integrated managed services model spanning people, process, technology, governance, service management and transformation.
* Define scope, architecture, operating model, transition approach, delivery footprint, staffing model, service levels, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Mobilise and lead multidisciplinary contributors across domains and geographies, ensuring one solution, one story and one commercial position.

**Create a compelling customer story**

* Frame the client’s business context, cyber risk and operational challenge before presenting the solution.
* Convert technical complexity into an outcome-led narrative that is relevant to CISOs, CIOs, business executives and procurement leaders.
* Connect solution choices to measurable outcomes such as risk reduction, resilience, control effectiveness, experience, operational efficiency and cost transparency.
* Lead executive discovery sessions, workshops, whiteboarding, solution walkthroughs, oral pitches and solution-defence discussions.
* Anticipate objections and competitive alternatives, articulating clearly why the proposition is credible, differentiated, scalable and valuable.

**Own commercial solutioning and pricing**

* Translate the solution into a robust bottom-up cost model covering resource pyramids, effort, delivery locations, platforms, licences, transition and ongoing run costs.
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive, sustainable and traceable pricing, with clear linkage between scope, service levels, cost and price.
* Evaluate fixed-price, consumption-based, unit-based, outcome-aligned and hybrid charging models based on client context and risk allocation.
* Optimise the solution through automation, standardisation, global delivery leverage, right-shoring, reusable assets and platform choices without compromising outcomes.
* Understand margin drivers, contingencies, contractual dependencies and change levers; support commercial governance, negotiation, BAFO and renewal decisions.

**Architect integrated turnkey cyber services**

* Provide broad solution leadership across Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Customer IAM, Non-Human Identity, Threat Detection and Response, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting.
* Bring familiarity with major platforms including SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk and CrowdStrike.
* Design for cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments, integrating EY capabilities, alliance partners, technology vendors and client-retained responsibilities.
* Know when to make an architectural decision and when to engage a deep specialist, while retaining accountability for the integrity of the end-to-end solution.
* Position AI-enabled security operations, automation and platform-led delivery where they create a credible and measurable client advantage.

**Build repeatable deal-engine capability**

* Create and improve reference architectures, solution patterns, estimators, pricing models, proposal content, assumptions libraries and executive storytelling assets.
* Capture pursuit insights, commercial benchmarks and lessons learned to improve future speed, consistency and win quality.
* Coach solution contributors on structured solutioning, client storytelling, estimation discipline and executive presentation.

**Decision scope and influence**

* Recommends the end-to-end solution strategy, architecture, delivery model and commercial assumptions for assigned pursuits.
* Challenges requirements and design choices that reduce value, increase delivery risk or weaken competitiveness.
* Balances client outcomes, architectural integrity, delivery feasibility, commercial sustainability and speed to market.
* Influences partners, pursuit leaders, SMEs, alliances, delivery executives and commercial stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Escalates material solution, delivery, contractual and financial risks with clear options and recommendations.

**Measures of success**

* Pursuit impact: Quality and competitiveness of strategic proposals; contribution to progression and wins.
* Client impact: Clarity of the story, executive confidence and alignment to measurable outcomes.
* Commercial quality: Accurate, traceable estimates and sustainable pricing with risks made explicit.
* Solution integrity: Integrated, scalable and deliverable solutions with clear ownership and dependencies.
* Execution discipline: Timely mobilisation, governance and high-quality outputs under pursuit deadlines.
* Capability uplift: Reusable assets, improved consistency and stronger solutioning maturity across the engine.

**Experience And Capabilities**

* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in cyber consulting, solution architecture, pre-sales or managed services, with demonstrated leadership of large and complex pursuits.
* Proven ability to move fluently between executive business conversations, cyber architecture, operating model design and commercial/pricing discussions.
* Depth in at least one major cyber domain, combined with sufficient breadth to shape integrated solutions across multiple capabilities.
* Practical experience building bottom-up estimates, cost models and pricing inputs for managed services opportunities.
* Exceptional customer presence, storytelling, writing, facilitation and presentation skills, including leadership of oral pitches and solution defence.
* Strong analytical judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs under ambiguity, commercial pressure and demanding deadlines.
* Experience working across distributed global teams and with alliance partners, technology vendors, finance, legal, risk and contracting stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree such as BTech/BE or equivalent; MCA or another relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

**Preferred Credentials And Exposure**

* Relevant certifications in security architecture, IAM, cloud security, SIEM/SOC or major technology platforms.
* Experience in competitive deal shaping, transformation programmes, renewals and transition from incumbent providers.
* Experience creating reusable propositions, reference architectures, estimators or pricing assets.
* Working knowledge of regulatory, legal, compliance and contractual considerations for managed services.
* Ability to operate effectively with international stakeholders and support Europe and US working hours when required.

**Leadership profile**

* Client-first: listens before designing and anchors the proposition in the client’s priorities.
* Commercially astute: understands that the strongest architecture must also be executable, priceable and competitive.
* Persuasive: makes complex ideas simple and turns technical capability into business value.
* Integrative: creates alignment across specialists, geographies, partners and competing priorities.
* Accountable: owns the quality and integrity of the whole solution, not only an individual component.
* Composed under pressure: brings structure, pace and judgement to high-value pursuits with incomplete information.

**Why this role matters**
The Cyber Solutions Architect will directly influence the quality, differentiation and commercial strength of EY’s most strategic turnkey cyber services pursuits. The role offers the opportunity to shape major client transformations, work across leading technology ecosystems and build the repeatable solutioning capability of the Cyber Large Deal Engine.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Computer Aided Design Engineer
description:
TeleBortiX is building state-of-the-art airborne systems.

You will design the mechanical hardware that holds our aircraft together and the equipment that lets us build and test them — airframe structures, mechanisms, enclosures, mounts, and integration hardware on the product side; test rigs, fixtures, tooling, and ground support equipment on the machinery side. You'll take parts and assemblies from concept through to production-ready CAD, drawings, and hand-off to manufacturing.

This is a hands-on design role with real engineering depth. You will own your designs end to end: the geometry, the tolerances, the load paths, the manufacturability, and the DFMEA. You will scope and review vendor work on detailed CAD and fabrication, and you will be in the loop from first sketch through bench integration.

This role interfaces across TeleBortiX's product line and sits alongside our powertrain, aero, materials, and manufacturing leads.

Key Responsibilities

* Design airframe structures, mechanisms, enclosures, brackets, and integration hardware for our airborne platforms — concept through production-ready models and dimensioned drawings.
* Design machinery and equipment: bench-test rigs, assembly and integration fixtures, tooling, and ground support equipment.
* Own parts and assemblies end to end — geometry, tolerance stack-ups (GD&T), mass properties, load paths, and design for manufacture and assembly across composites, sheet metal, machined, and additive parts.
* Run and interpret structural analysis (hand calcs and FEA); iterate designs against strength, stiffness, weight, and cost targets.
* Support prototyping, bench integration, and iteration — build it, test it, learn, revise.
* Produce and maintain clean drawing packages, BOMs, and configuration/version control.
* Scope and review vendor and contractor work on detailed CAD and fabrication.
* Own the mechanical DFMEA and contribute to design reviews.
* Interface with the Powertrain lead (motor mounts, battery and enclosure mounting, thermal packaging), the Aerodynamics lead (aerostructures, control surfaces), the Materials & Processes lead (composites, thermal composites), and the Manufacturing & Test lead (integration, qualification).

Requirements

Candidates should meet
**four of the six**
criteria below to apply.

* Formal engineering qualification in Mechanical, Automotive, Aerospace, or a related field —
  **OR**
  demonstrated equivalent technical capability through portfolio, published work, or prior shipped hardware.
* Experience designing and shipping mechanical hardware. We're open across levels: a strong recent graduate with a serious portfolio and a senior engineer with a decade of production work are both encouraged to apply — make your level clear and let the work speak.
* You have owned at least one part or assembly from concept through to manufacture, deployment, or customer hand-off.
* Proficiency in a major 3D CAD environment ([SolidWorks / CATIA / Creo / NX]) with the ability to draft to standard (ASME Y14.5 or ISO), and comfort running FEA for sizing and validation.
* Genuine ownership mindset — you scope, design, prototype, test, and iterate; you don't wait to be told what to do next.
* Hands-on experience with lightweight structures, composites, or aerospace / UAV mechanical hardware —
  **or**
  transferable depth from automotive, motorsport, robotics, or precision machinery.

*Note: Candidates whose skills or qualifications fall short of the criteria above may still apply if their interests are strongly aligned with TeleBortiX's vision. Make the case in your application note.*

Strongly preferred

* Composites and lightweight-structures design (layup, bonded joints, metal-to-composite interfaces).
* Drafting Skills
* Aerospace or UAV experience — fixed-wing or multi-rotor airframe, mechanism, or integration hardware.
* FEA depth ([Ansys / Nastran / Abaqus]) — static, modal, and basic fatigue.
* Design for manufacture across several processes: CNC machining, sheet metal, injection moulding, additive, and composite layup.
* Mechanism and actuation design — deployment, articulation, control-surface linkages, latching.
* Fluent GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.
* Test-rig, fixture, and ground-support-equipment design (the machinery side of the role).
* Secondary depth in an adjacent cluster — thermal, materials, or manufacturing. Every engineer here owns one primary cluster and a credible secondary.

Tools & standards

3D CAD (SolidWorks / CATIA ) • FEA (Ansys) • ASME Y14.5 GD&T • PDM / PLM • DFM/DFA across machined, sheet-metal, molded, additive, and composite parts.

Org Structure

You will report directly to the Director, Engineering. You will work closely with our Powertrain architect, Aerodynamics Lead (aerostructures, performance), Materials & Processes Lead (composites, thermal), and Manufacturing & Test Lead (integration, qual testing).

About TeleBortiX

We build state-of-the-art airborne systems. Our engineering team is small and multi-skilled. We hire for skills, not for job titles. Every engineer here owns one primary cluster and a credible secondary.

Location, compensation, and how to apply

* **Location:**
  Delhi / NCR / Bengaluru
  **Compensation:**
  Commensurate with experience; equity component negotiable.
  **To apply:**
  Send your CV and a note on an interesting mechanical design challenge you've solved — what the problem was, and how you approached it.

title: Agentic Growth Marketer
description:
**Agentic Growth Marketer**

**10-12 LPA**

**Location: Bangalore, Koramangala**

**Build the future of marketing. Not another marketing campaign.**

**Company:**
**Porcellia**

**Experience:**
No minimum years required

**Mandatory background:**
Engineering, software development, data, or a closely related quantitative field

**The opportunity**

We believe the future of marketing will be built by people who understand both marketing and technology.

Not marketers who occasionally use ChatGPT.

Not developers who build AI tools without understanding the business problems they’re solving.

We’re looking for someone who sits at the intersection of
**engineering, data, AI agents, and marketing.**

Someone who can look at a marketing problem and think,
*“Why is a human still doing this?”*

Someone who understands how agents work, how to connect them, how to make them reliable, and how to turn them into systems that produce measurable business outcomes.

**You don’t need to be a great marketer yet. I’ll teach you that.**

You need to be an exceptional problem solver who loves numbers, understands technology, and is obsessed with what AI makes possible.

**What you’ll actually do**

Your job is simple:
**Learn marketing. Then agentify it.**

You’ll work directly with me to understand how some of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands are built and scaled.

Then you’ll turn that knowledge into intelligent systems.

You’ll:

* Build AI agents that solve real marketing problems across creative strategy, performance marketing, analytics, CRO, retention, and growth.
* Create agentic workflows that can research, reason, execute, evaluate, and improve with minimal human intervention.
* Connect LLMs, APIs, databases, marketing platforms, and automation tools into working systems.
* Turn complex marketing decisions into repeatable, scalable processes.
* Work with large amounts of data to find patterns, identify opportunities, and make better decisions.
* Experiment constantly with new models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities.
* Build solutions that don’t just save time, but actually make businesses more money.

**The goal isn’t to automate what marketers do today. It’s to build what marketers will be capable of doing tomorrow.**

**Who we’re looking for**

**1. You understand agents. Really well.**

You should know the difference between an AI chatbot, a workflow, and an autonomous agent.

You should be comfortable with concepts like tool calling, MCP, orchestration, memory, context engineering, APIs, evaluation, and multi-agent systems.

You don’t need to know every framework. But you should be the kind of person who experiments with new AI capabilities before everyone else starts talking about them.

**You should have built things. Not just watched tutorials about them.**

**2. You’re exceptionally good with numbers.**

You should be able to do mental math faster than most people can reach for a calculator.

Percentages, ratios, growth rates, margins, unit economics, probability, and data interpretation should come naturally to you.

You should be able to look at a spreadsheet and quickly figure out what’s happening, what’s wrong, and what matters.

Because great marketing is ultimately a numbers game.

**3. You have a technical or quantitative background.**

This is mandatory.

Ideally, you’re a software developer, data analyst, data scientist, engineer, or someone from a quantitative finance background.

You should be comfortable with structured thinking, logic, and solving problems using technology.

You don’t need a computer science degree. You do need to demonstrate genuine technical ability.

**4. You love marketing.**

You should be genuinely curious about why people buy things.

Why does one advertisement work while another fails? Why do people pay more for one brand than another? Why do some products become categories of their own?

You should find consumer psychology, copywriting, persuasion, business models, and growth fascinating.

You don’t need formal marketing experience. But you need to want to become world-class at it.

**5. You’re a builder, not a spectator.**

You should be someone who experiments relentlessly.

Someone who would rather build a working prototype over the weekend than spend two weeks discussing whether it’s possible.

You don’t wait for instructions. You find problems worth solving and start solving them.

**What you’ll get**

**I’ll teach you everything I know about marketing.**

You’ll learn how positioning works, how to create winning advertisements, how to read performance data, how to understand consumer behaviour, and how to build profitable growth engines.

You’ll get to work on real problems with real businesses, real budgets, and real consequences.

And then you’ll use your technical skills to turn that knowledge into products, agents, and systems.

You’ll be working at the frontier of a rapidly changing industry.

While most marketing teams are learning how to use AI tools,
**you’ll be building the tools and systems that redefine how marketing works.**

You won’t be joining a marketing team that simply follows instructions.

You’ll be helping create the future that other marketing teams eventually follow.

**Who should NOT apply**

* You’re looking for a conventional marketing job.
* Your understanding of AI is limited to writing prompts in ChatGPT.
* You dislike spreadsheets, calculations, or quantitative problems.
* You enjoy talking about ideas more than building them.
* You want a clearly defined role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day.

**Our hiring process**

We don’t care how many years you’ve worked.

We care how you think, what you can build, and how quickly you learn.

**Round 1: Make a video that catches our attention.**

This is the first and most important filter.

Make a video introducing yourself and convincing us why you should be the person building the future of marketing with us.

Show us how you think. Show us what you’ve built. Show us why you’re different.

There is no prescribed format.

You can be creative, technical, funny, analytical, or completely unconventional.

**We will shortlist candidates based on their videos. Not their resumes.**

**Round 2: Live interview**

If your video catches our attention, we’ll invite you for a live interview.

We’ll test two things:

1. **Data fluency:**
   Mental math, business logic, numerical reasoning, and your ability to make sense of unfamiliar data.
2. **Copywriting:**
   Your ability to understand people, communicate clearly, and persuade through words.

You don’t need to know marketing jargon. We’re looking for raw ability, not rehearsed answers.

**Salary**

10-12 LPA

title: Head of Marathi Content
description:
**हे वाचता येतंय? मग तुमच्या आजोबांना विचारा, त्यांच्या जमिनीच्या सातबाऱ्यावर कोणाचं नाव आहे. त्या उत्तरामागची गोष्ट सांगणारी व्यक्ती आम्हाला हवी आहे.**

BhuMe is hiring a Head of Marathi Content to own our Marathi voice, creators and organic reach across Maharashtra. Full-time in Bangalore, ₹10 to 12 LPA fixed and ESOPs if you perform well, reporting to the founders.

**Why this matters**

Why does the Indian judiciary take 7 years on average to resolve disputes? Because over 70% of stuck cases are property disputes. They are complex because the Government doesn't guarantee ownership of property. ₹2 lakh crore is frozen every year because no one can verify who owns what. Ask your family and you will hear the stories.

**About BhuMe**

BhuMe is the intelligence layer for real estate, serving over 3.5 lakh users in Maharashtra. We have helped over 1 lakh farmers make sure their land is legally safe. We bring scattered, hard-to-read land records together so people can check a title, track changes on their land, and make decisions with confidence. We're a small team: the work you ship reaches real users quickly.

**The role**

You'll own BhuMe's voice in Marathi: our own channels, the creators we work with, and the new Marathi ads we put out every week. You'll tell the stories behind land records in the Marathi people actually speak, and get the right Marathi creators to tell them too.

You're judged on one number: paid orders per rupee spent. Views are how you get there, not the goal. You make the posts yourself; this is not a role for managing an agency.

Marathi YouTube has plenty of videos on how to download a 7/12. Almost nobody tells the story behind one, the sale that went wrong or the name that never got changed, in a way people forward to the family WhatsApp group. That story is yours to tell.

**What you'll do**

* Write, shoot and edit Marathi short videos (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) yourself, every week: app screen recordings, talking heads, skits, and real stories told with permission
* Make new Marathi ads every week for our paid campaigns, and turn the ones that sell into more posts
* Find and sign Marathi creators and influencers in farming, rural life, comedy, news and personal finance, and pay them for the views and orders they bring, not for follower counts
* Get creators across Maharashtra to film real stories in the villages: you find the story and write the hook, they shoot it on the ground
* Give every creator and every post its own tracked link, so we know which ones bring paid orders and not just views
* Keep a ledger of every post: the idea, who it's for, the hook, views, cost per 1,000 views, installs and orders. Kill what doesn't sell and double down on what does
* Build BhuMe's own Marathi channels on Instagram and YouTube
* Keep it honest: label paid posts as ads the way ASCI requires, show the government source, and never let anyone think BhuMe is a government office

**What we require**

* Marathi you'd use at home, not textbook Marathi: you write and talk the way people across Maharashtra actually do
* Proof you can get views cheaply: posts you made or ran, with real view counts and what each one cost
* An account you grew yourself, your own or a brand's, and the numbers to show how
* You judge a post by what it sells, not by how many people saw it
* You shoot and edit on your phone and can turn an idea into a post the same day
* Comfort with numbers: CPM, cost per install, cost per order. A spreadsheet doesn't scare you
* You're funny in Marathi. We'll check

**Nice to have**

* You're a Marathi creator yourself
* You've paid creators per view or per result, with tracked links or codes
* You know rural Maharashtra: farming, land, and the family fights over property
* You've run creator posts as ads on Meta or YouTube

**What we don't want**

* Rage-bait, fake followers or bought views. We'll look at your analytics live
* Content that mocks real people's land disputes or shows their documents without permission

**How we work**

* Slope over intercept: come in with energy and capacity for growth, and we'll throw you as much rope as you're willing to catch
* Comically fast: a customer has a crazy request? Spot it, ship within 12 hours and get back to them, without a single meeting
* Stepping on toes encouraged: work in any area or product that gets the job done for customers faster. No red tape
* Humble: our customers move the needle; BhuMe gives them peace of mind. Low ego, service minded

**What we offer**

* ₹10 to 12 LPA fixed, and ESOPs if you perform well
* Full-time in Bangalore, on-site preferred, with flexible working hours
* A budget for creators and tests, and room to get some of it wrong while you find what works
* BhuMe's Marathi voice is yours from day one, with a direct line from your work to revenue
* A meaningful problem: making land information accessible to millions
* Access to the best AI tools, and a mini MBA in building a customer-centric organisation

**How to apply**

Apply here with Easy Apply. At the top of your CV, add links to 3 posts you made or ran, with the views and what each cost, and one Marathi hook for BhuMe in one line. We shortlist from your posts and your numbers.

1. Your application: 3 posts, their numbers, one Marathi hook
2. Screen-share, 45 min: open your analytics live, no screenshots. Walk us through one post that worked and one that went viral but sold nothing, and tell us why
3. Paid trial week: we pay you pro rata to this role's salary and give you a budget to make Marathi posts and book your first creators. We judge it on cost per paid order, not views
4. Founders, 45 min: final conversation

More about the role: https://www.bhume.in/careers/head-of-marathi-content

We only ever email you from an @bhume.in address, and we never ask for fees or deposits.

title: ADAS Architect - Simulation, Data & Verification Platform
description:
**About The Team**
You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle.
  
  
**Role purpose**
The Simulation, Data & Verification Platform Architect defines and builds the engineering platform on which every ADAS algorithm in the organization is developed, verified, and released. This is not the integration or configuration of an existing framework: the role creates, from the ground up, a proprietary simulation engine and developer application, the automated verification and reporting system that runs on it, and the data platform that feeds both, from recorded vehicle data through labelling to cloud-scale execution.
  
  
The platform is the primary evidence base for every function, before and after vehicles are available. Its correctness, determinism, and traceability directly determine the credibility of every result the organization reports. The role calls for a senior architect with deep software engineering skill, strong automotive domain understanding, and a record of building platforms that entire engineering teams depend on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Simulation engine and developer application**

* Architect and build a proprietary simulation engine that executes any algorithm component delivered as a host-agnostic C-API library, discovering the component's ports and configuration at run time rather than through hand-written integration.
* Define the execution model: closed-loop simulation, deterministic resimulation against recorded data, and pure replay as distinct, well-defined modes; multi-rate scheduling; and multi-component pipelines in which any stage can run live, stubbed, or injected from a recording.
* Design and build the interactive developer application: timeline and transport control, 2D/3D scene view, signal plots, port and message inspection, layer-based visualization contributed by each component as plug-ins, and side-by-side comparison of runs.
* Guarantee traceability: every value displayed or reported is traceable to the recording, message, build, and configuration that produced it, and the headless command-line interface produces answers identical to the GUI.
* Establish determinism as a measured property: bit-exact resimulation within and across processes, and tracked, explained differences across builds and machines.
* Provide process isolation, timeouts, and crash capture so that a failing component never takes down a run or a campaign.
* Integrate external simulators and scenario tools (e.g., CarMaker, CARLA, esmini) through codecs and adapters, without coupling any algorithm component to a specific tool.

**Automated verification and reporting framework**

* Design and build, from zero, the automated test framework that runs scenario campaigns on the simulation engine: scenario definitions with machine-checkable acceptance criteria, parameter sweeps, and NCAP-based and India-specific scenario libraries.
* Build automated reporting for every campaign: per-scenario verdicts with evidence, function KPIs, coverage against requirements, trend and regression tracking, and drill-down from any failed case to the exact moment in the recording.
* Implement regression gates in CI that block a change when a KPI, scenario outcome, or determinism check regresses.
* Link verification results to requirements so that traceability and coverage reports are generated automatically, never maintained by hand.

**Data platform: recordings, storage, labelling, and cloud execution**

* Define the recording data model and formats (e.g., MCAP, MDF4, rosbag), including embedded schemas and provenance (vehicle, sensor set, software build, configuration, and scenario identity).
* Architect storage and data management for large volumes of vehicle recordings: ingestion from test vehicles, indexing, metadata and search, retention, dataset versioning, and access control.
* Establish labelling and annotation pipelines for ground truth: tool selection or development, auto-labelling, quality control, annotation specifications, and management of external annotation vendors.
* Build scenario extraction and mining from recorded data, turning field drives into reusable, parameterized test scenarios.
* Architect cloud and cluster execution of resimulation and scenario campaigns at scale (thousands of runs), including job orchestration, containerization, cost control, and reproducibility of every run.

**Technical leadership**

* Own the technical roadmap of the platform and make build-versus-buy decisions with clear justification.
* Set engineering standards for the platform: code quality, testing, documentation, and backward compatibility of interfaces.
* Work with algorithm, perception, test, and integration teams as internal customers, and with the ECU-in-the-Loop Test & Release Architect so that SIL, HIL, and vehicle results share one reporting system.
* Mentor engineers and, as the platform grows, build and lead the team around it.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (PhD a plus) in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* 7-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years architecting simulation, SIL/HIL, data, or verification platforms for ADAS, autonomous driving, or robotics.
* Demonstrated design and delivery, from scratch, of a simulation or resimulation platform adopted as the primary development and regression tool of an engineering organization.
* Expert-level C++ (C++17) and Python: C ABIs, dynamic library loading, plug-in architectures, cross-language bindings, and performance-critical, multi-threaded code on Windows and Linux.
* Experience building desktop engineering applications with rich visualization (e.g., Qt, Dear ImGui, OpenGL/Vulkan, or equivalent).
* Deep knowledge of recorded-data formats and large-scale handling of automotive sensor data (camera, radar, lidar, vehicle bus).
* Hands-on experience with ground-truth labelling and annotation workflows for ADAS data, including quality metrics.
* Proven experience with cloud or cluster execution (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containerized batch workloads) for simulation or data processing at scale.
* Strong knowledge of build, packaging, and CI (CMake, Conan or equivalent, and modern CI systems).
* Experience with schema-driven interfaces (e.g., Protocol Buffers) and long-term interface versioning.
* Working knowledge of ADAS function behaviour, NCAP test protocols, and scenario-based testing (ASAM OpenSCENARIO / OpenDRIVE).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building a scenario-mining or data-driven test-generation pipeline from fleet or test-vehicle data.
* Experience with auto-labelling using offline perception models.
* Experience with verification in regulated contexts (ISO 26262, ISO 21448 SOTIF, ASPICE) and with tool qualification.
* Contributions to open-source simulation, robotics, or data tooling.
* Experience leading or growing a platform team.
* Advanced use of AI-assisted software development tools to accelerate platform development.

**Key competencies**

* Ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly to engineers and leadership to drive technical decisions.
* Architectural judgement: designs that stay simple as components, functions, and data volumes grow by orders of magnitude.
* Uncompromising rigor in determinism, traceability, and reproducibility: a result that cannot be traced is not accepted as a result.
* A product mindset toward internal tools: engineers adopt the platform because it is the fastest way to work, not because it is mandated.
* Ownership from first design to organization-wide daily use, without reliance on handoffs.
* Ability to build new systems where architecture and processes are still being defined, and to make them the reference for the organization.
* Clear technical communication with engineers, architects, and management.

**L&T Company Overview / About Us**
L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
  
  
Given L&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM).
